title: Scaffold the navigation-core kernel library (navigation-x vendored + BeSpunky reusable additions)

name.description: The library (and Nx project) name. Defaults to navigation-core.

directory.description: The LIBRARY's directory (the kernel goes in its src/). Defaults to <libs-dir>/<name>, where <libs-dir> is detected from the workspace (nx.json workspaceLayout.libsDir, else where existing libraries live, else packages).

importPath.description: The library's import path. Defaults to @<workspace-scope>/<name>.
